title: Reading Drill — Maintaining cobbled streets — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Maintaining cobbled streets — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Elmbrook began with reports of loose stones moving under delivery trolleys. The street repair supervisor had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using site inspections and chose the number of displaced stones as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was different packing around repaired stones. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted five weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the weight of deliveries as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
